number_policy.constructor: finite values only; preserve all binary64 bits including signed zero and subnormal payloads
number_policy.constructor_failure: zero handle; error 3 for non-finite input
number_policy.getter_decimal_rounding: nearest, ties to even; integer multiprecision in nC
number_policy.getter_decimal_overflow: signed infinity; original lexical JSON number retained
number_policy.getter_decimal_underflow: gradual subnormal rounding or signed zero
number_policy.default: fallback bits unchanged for a non-number, including NaN payloads
number_policy.format: deterministic round-trip decimal with at most 17 significant digits; fixed/exponential policy, not minimum total text length

calling_convention.windows: positional XMM0-XMM3; 32-byte shadow space; remaining arguments on stack; float return in XMM0
calling_convention.linux: independent six-GPR and eight-XMM banks; remaining arguments on stack; float return in XMM0

ownership: explicit jsonRelease and free for caller-owned serialized strings; caller serializes access to shared JSON handle table
